Class QueryPartFactory

java.lang.Object

    • generateClassification

      public static ClassificationType generateClassification​(java.lang.String classificationId, java.lang.String registryObjectId, ObjectTypes type, java.lang.String value, java.util.List<SlotType1> slots, InternationalStringType name)
      builds classification element in following structure: 
       
 <rim:Classification classificationScheme="urn:uuid:41a5887f-8865-4c09-adf7-e362475b143a" classifiedObject="urn:uuid:9f4cbb3a-ff4c-18f6-3113-467490e52bbd" id="c1591284372968-22750440173389305851" nodeRepresentation="11369-6">
     <rim:Slot name="codingScheme">
         <rim:ValueList>
             <rim:Value>2.16.840.1.113883.6.1</rim:Value>
         </rim:ValueList>
     </rim:Slot>
     <rim:Name>
         <rim:LocalizedString charset="UTF-8" value="HISTORY OF IMMUNIZATIONS"/>
     </rim:Name>
 </rim:Classification>
      Parameters:
      classificationId - ID of classification scheme or node
      registryObjectId - ID of object
      type - object type of classification
      value - node representation to include
      slots - to include
      name - display name of value
      Returns:
      created ClassificationType

    • generateResponseOption

      public static ResponseOptionType generateResponseOption​(ResponseOptionType.ReturnType.Enum returnType, boolean returnComposedObject)
      builds response option element in following structure 
       
  <query:ResponseOption returnComposedObjects="true" returnType="LeafClass"/>
      There are two different types for return values:
      • ObjectRef (a list of object references)
      • LeafClass (list of XML elements representing leaf class of object)
      .
      Parameters:
      returnType - type for returning objects (LeafClass and ObjectRef)
      returnComposedObject - the return composed object
      Returns:
      created ResponseOptionType

    • generateRequestSecurityTokenDocument

      public static RequestSecurityTokenDocument generateRequestSecurityTokenDocument​(ELGAETSTokenTypeType.Enum tokenType, ELGARequestTypeEnum.Enum requestType, java.lang.String dialect, ClaimTypeType... claimTypes) throws org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException
       
 <RequestSecurityToken xmlns="http://docs.oasis-open.org/ws-sx/ws-trust/200512">
  <TokenType>urn:elga:bes:2013:HCP:assertion</TokenType>

      <ClaimValue>702</ClaimValue>
    </ClaimType>
  </Claims>
 </RequestSecurityToken>
      Parameters:
      tokenType - text content of element token type
      requestType - text content of element request type
      dialect - dialect of element claims
      claimTypes - list of claim types to include
      Returns:
      created RequestSecurityTokenDocument
      Throws:
      org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException - the xml exception

    • buildSecurityHeader

      public static SecurityDocument buildSecurityHeader​(AssertionType hcpAssertion) throws org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException
      builds security document element. First "xml-fragment" element is replaced by "saml2:Assertion" in passed hcpAssertion. Afterward it includes assertion in security element. 
       
 <wsse:Security xmlns:wsse="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-secext-1.0.xsd">
       <saml2:Assertion xmlns:saml2="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion"
         <!-- assertion content-->
       </saml2:Assertion>
 </wsse:Security>
      Parameters:
      hcpAssertion - assertion to include, it could be HCP or context assertion
      Returns:
      created SecurityDocument
      Throws:
      org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException - the xml exception
